key_highlights: ASX slumps sharply as miners and banks fall amid oil price spike driven by US-Iran military strikes; bond yields spike on rate-hike fears
Mortgage stress hits 18-year highs; analysts warn house prices could fall 10% as fourth RBA rate hike looms
Australia's productivity deteriorates 'bad to worse'; inflation confirmed as domestically driven, complicating RBA policy
CSL signs deal with US Trump administration to slash medicine prices, raising margin concerns for CSL.AX
Sydney property developer Bathla warns it may fold within days; 'Evergrande moment' narrative gains traction
Coal sector booms on energy security demand; Mount Lyell copper mine to reopen boosting WA miners
Qantas ground crews vote for right to strike amid pay dispute, adding operational risk to QAN.AX
Global debt spiral and AI bubble contagion risk flagged by top central bankers

sectors.trend: Mixed: large-cap miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) under pressure from ASX broad selloff, but coal booms on energy security; small-caps active with King River 44g/t gold, McLaren titanium grades surge, Mount Lyell copper reopening, Larvotto antimony
sectors.implications: Coal names (WDS.AX, BRL.AX) benefit from oil spike and energy security; copper (SGR.AX, MRL.AX) supported by Lyell reopening; gold (GOLD.AX, NVG.AX) gains from geopolitical risk premium

sectors.trend: Banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) fall on ASX selloff; mortgage stress at 18-year highs signals rising NIM pressure and credit risk; CBA inactive-card fee scandal adds reputational drag
sectors.implications: Rate hike cycle supports NIM but credit losses from housing stress and developer defaults (Bathla) offset gains; sector under pressure

sectors.trend: Oil hits two-month high on US-Iran strikes; diesel shock persists; coal demand surges
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, BRL.AX, SXG.AX benefit from elevated oil/coal; downstream refiners face margin compression from diesel costs

sectors.trend: CSL.AX signs US price-cut deal with Trump administration, compressing US revenue margins
sectors.implications: Near-term margin headwind for CSL.AX; offset by volume growth and non-US markets; monitor deal terms

sectors.trend: Housing 'bloodbath' fears; per capita recession; developer defaults; retail weak (Denny's Chapter 11, kids clothing closures)
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and valuation risk; consumer discretionary under pressure; staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) relatively defensive

sectors.trend: AI bubble concerns intensify; central banker warns contagion risk; Nvidia-OpenAI circular financing flagged; Palantir ARR milestone positive but sector volatile
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (WTC.AX, CNU.AX) face sentiment spillover; Canva (CVA) privacy legal fight adds governance risk

key_themes: US-Iran conflict driving oil spike and global risk-off
RBA rate hike cycle vs. domestic inflation and housing stress
Productivity deterioration and per capita recession
Property developer contagion risk (Bathla, Evergrande parallel)
AI bubble and global debt spiral as systemic risks
Commodity strength in coal, copper, gold offsets broad equity weakness

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US-Iran military escalation driving oil spike and global risk-off
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; increase allocation to gold (GOLD.AX) and defensive staples; monitor Brent crude and AUD/USD

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction and developer defaults (Bathla, Evergrande parallel)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and property-linked exposure; monitor bank NPLs; favour cash-rich developers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike and rising bond yields compressing equity valuations
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour dividend-paying large caps; reduce duration-sensitive growth names; monitor 10-yr GBA yield

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Qantas strike action disrupting aviation and consumer sentiment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor QAN.AX volatility; assess impact on tourism-linked REITs and consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI bubble and global debt spiral triggering broader market correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from concentrated tech/AI exposure; maintain cash buffers; monitor US credit spreads

risk_assessment.risk_factor: CSL US price-cut deal compressing healthcare margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reassess CSL.AX valuation on revised US revenue assumptions; monitor peer healthcare names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight coal and energy names on oil spike and energy security demand
opportunities.rationale: US-Iran conflict and diesel shock support sustained elevated oil/coal prices; WDS and BRL benefit directly

opportunities.recommendation: Add gold and copper exposure on geopolitical risk and Lyell reopening
opportunities.rationale: Gold benefits from safe-haven flows; copper supported by Mount Lyell restart and structural demand

opportunities.recommendation: Selective small-cap mining exploration plays with strong assay results
opportunities.rationale: King River 44g/t gold, McLaren titanium surge, Larvotto antimony offer asymmetric upside in risk-off environment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure; increase cash and short-duration bonds
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing 'bloodbath' scenario, 10% price fall risk, developer defaults (Bathla) and 18-year mortgage stress peak

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank exposure pending credit loss visibility; favour WBC.AX for dividend yield
defensive_moves.rationale: Mortgage stress and developer defaults raise NPL risk; WBC offers relative value and yield

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity portfolio with gold and defensive staples; avoid AI/tech concentration
defensive_moves.rationale: AI contagion risk, global debt spiral, and rate-hike fears create tail risk for growth equities

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months: oil-driven inflation, RBA rate hike, housing stress, and geopolitical risk from US-Iran conflict dominate. Miners and banks lead declines; coal and gold are relative outperformers. Expect elevated volatility and AUD weakness on capital outflows.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious: productivity deterioration and per capita recession constrain earnings growth. Housing correction may deepen. However, commodity strength (coal, copper, gold) and energy security themes provide sector-specific support. RBA likely to peak rates, offering eventual relief. Structural AI/debt risks warrant ongoing caution.

CSL US deal terms and margin impact

RBA cash rate and forward guidance
Australian mortgage stress and NPL data
Global AI/tech sentiment and credit spreads
